Assignment detail

Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S05

Explain submission requirements, personal dates, published evaluation and current attempt state before work is added. A contextual more-time request is distinct from an approved extension.

Permissions
  • Students act on own eligible individual/group work only.
  • TAs cannot approve allowances; instructors handle W46.
  • Course policy overrides generic tool directory permissions; medical basis never shown to peers.
Responsive
  • Requirements precede action rail on narrow web; deadline remains near Add work.
  • Rubric opens readable stacked criteria with no horizontal-only table.
Accessibility
  • Dates include explicit timezone and personal/course labels.
  • Disabled submission action has a nearby reason and next recovery step.
Data
  • Published assignment/version, rubric reference, formats/limits and timing.
  • Own draft, immutable attempt summaries, group eligibility and allowance outcome.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Adding files or requesting more time cannot create a receipt or change deadline.
  • A late allowance updates the personal date consistently across W18/W07.
  • A direct Add work URL for an unassigned group member remains blocked.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
